instructions.purpose: Record consequential implementation choices and promotion status. This file does not override context/docs or contracts.
instructions.promotionRule: If a decision changes durable product or architecture truth, update the controlling Markdown and machine contracts in the same governed change.

decisions.title: One published create-project package for V1
decisions.decision: Implement LoadedVibes initially as one TypeScript CLI package with generator runtime and canonical template in the same repository rather than a multi-package framework.
decisions.rationale: The product requires a thin deterministic initializer first; split packages only when an independent boundary is proven.

decisions.title: Use create-loaded-vibes as package and bin identity
decisions.decision: The canonical V1 package and executable are create-loaded-vibes.
decisions.rationale: Matches create-project package conventions and makes the product category explicit.

decisions.title: Support pnpm only in V1
decisions.decision: The generator and generated-project acceptance path support pinned pnpm rather than abstracting over package managers.
decisions.rationale: Package-manager choice is not legitimate product variability for the canonical baseline.

decisions.title: Use staging-first generation
decisions.decision: Generate through a run-owned sibling staging directory and reject non-empty targets.
decisions.rationale: Provides deterministic cleanup and prevents destructive partial writes.

decisions.title: Use one standard preset before module generalization
decisions.decision: V1 ships the canonical standard preset. Optional capabilities require explicit module contracts; the first proof does not create a generic plugin framework.
decisions.rationale: Loaded Vibes exposes only validated product variability.

decisions.title: No provider provisioning or deployment in V1
decisions.decision: The CLI generates safe configuration examples and Vercel-oriented support but does not collect credentials, provision providers, or deploy.
decisions.rationale: Deterministic local generation and validation must be reliable before external side effects are introduced.

decisions.title: Generated governance is product output
decisions.decision: Every generated repository includes human context, machine contracts, execution state, AGENTS.md, and validation ownership.
decisions.rationale: Codependent Coding and Codex must inherit known architecture rather than rediscover it.

decisions.title: Acceptance success requires executed generated-project validation
decisions.decision: Default success wording is reserved for output whose required credential-free acceptance gate actually passed. --skip-install output is reported as unvalidated.
decisions.rationale: Evidence must not exceed executed checks.

decisions.title: Keep Stripe Connect in the fixed canonical baseline
decisions.decision: V1 preserves Stripe Connect as production-isolated canonical template capability and does not expose architecture selection through an optional-module prompt.
decisions.rationale: The current product instruction defines a complete opinionated stack rather than a choose-your-own-stack initializer; the existing removal proof remains as template boundary evidence.
